GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_CHUI_DONG.title: Activate
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_CHUI_DONG.description: Choose and play a Gu card from the Gu Storage Pile; you choose the target for attacking Gu.
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_CHUI_DONG.selectionScre: Choose a Gu card to activate.
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_QING_TI_XIAN_YUAN.title: Green Grape Immortal Essence
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_QING_TI_XIAN_YUAN.descr: Retain as immortal essence. Provides {RemainingActivationUnits}/{ActivationUnits} rank-6 activation units; Exhaust this card when depleted.
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_HONG_ZAO_XIAN_YUAN.desc: Retain as immortal essence. Equals two Green Grape essences and provides {RemainingActivationUnits}/{ActivationUnits} rank-6 activation units; Exhaust this card when depleted.
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_BAI_LI_XIAN_YUAN.title: White Lychee Immortal Essence
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_BAI_LI_XIAN_YUAN.descri: Retain as immortal essence. Equals two Red Date essences and provides {RemainingActivationUnits}/{ActivationUnits} rank-6 activation units; Exhaust this card when depleted.
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_HUANG_XING_XIAN_YUAN.de: Retain as immortal essence. Equals two White Litchi essences and provides {RemainingActivationUnits}/{ActivationUnits} rank-6 activation units; Exhaust this card when depleted.
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_YUE_GUANG_GU.title: Moonlight Gu
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_YUE_GUANG_GU.descriptio: Can be activated {RemainingUses}/{MaxUses} times, then recovers for {RecoveryTurns} turns. Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. From rank 2, deal {ZhaoPoConditionBonus} more if the target already has [gold]Illumination Break[/gold]. From rank 3, create a [gold]Moonblade[/gold] while recovering. From rank 5, you may spend {GuangHuiCost} [gold]Brilliance[/gold] to empower it: deal {BonusDamage} more, apply {ZhaoPoPower:diff()} Illumination Break, and upgrade the generated Moonblade. From rank 6, Replay once only when empowered; Replay does not apply Illumination Break again.
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_XIAO_GUANG_GU.title: Little Light Gu
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_XIAO_GUANG_GU.descripti: Can be activated {RemainingUses}/{MaxUses} times, then recovers for {RecoveryTurns} turns. At ranks 1–5, only the first Little Light Gu each turn gains 1 [gold]Brilliance[/gold]; later copies focus light instead. From rank 2, also empowers the next Light Path Attack. From rank 3 it creates [gold]Glimmer[/gold] while recovering, becoming [gold]Focused Light[/gold] at rank 6 and [gold]Aurora[/gold] at rank 9.
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_YU_PI_GU.title: Jade Skin Gu
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_YU_PI_GU.description: Can be activated {RemainingUses}/{MaxUses} times, then recovers for {RecoveryTurns} turns. Gain {Block:diff()} Block. From rank 3, create [gold]Jade Membrane[/gold] while recovering; at rank 6 it becomes [gold]Jade Light Garment[/gold]; rank 8 also creates [gold]Refraction[/gold]; rank 9 creates [gold]Glazed Jade Garment[/gold]. From rank 5, gain 1 [gold]Brilliance[/gold] when activated.
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_YUE_MANG_GU.title: Moonbeam Gu
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_YUE_MANG_GU.description: Can be activated {RemainingUses}/{MaxUses} times. Deal {Damage:diff()} damage {Hits} times. You may spend {GuangHuiCost} [gold]Brilliance[/gold] to deal {BonusDamage} more damage per hit and apply {ZhaoPoPower:diff()} [gold]Illumination[/gold].{Rank:cond:>=6? NL [gold]Rank 6:[/gold] Every hit can trigger Illumination; Brilliance is paid only on the first segment.|}
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_XUAN_YU_ZHANG.title: Mystic Jade Palm
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_XUAN_YU_ZHANG.descripti: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. On the first segment, gain {Block:diff()} Block.{Rank:cond:>=7? NL [gold]Rank 7:[/gold] Costs 1 less Energy.|}{Rank:cond:>=8? NL [gold]Rank 8+:[/gold] Replay once; Replay repeats only the damage.|}
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_XUE_QI_GU.title: Blood Qi Gu
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_XUE_QI_GU.description: Can be activated {RemainingUses}/{MaxUses} times. Lose {HpLoss:diff()} HP and gain {XueYuanPower:diff()} [gold]Blood Essence[/gold]. At the start of your next turn, heal {Heal:diff()} HP. HP lost and healed are always equal. NL This Gu is capped at rank 5 and cannot become an Immortal Gu.
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_XUE_YUE_GU.title: Blood Moon Gu
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_XUE_YUE_GU.description: Can be activated {RemainingUses}/{MaxUses} times. Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies. On the first segment, apply {LiuXuePower:diff()} [gold]Bleed[/gold] to all surviving enemies; for every {BloodThreshold} [gold]Blood Essence[/gold], gain 1 total Blood Mark allocation and distribute it as evenly as possible in deterministic enemy order.{Rank:cond:>=7? NL [gold]Rank 7:[/gold] Replay once; Replay repeats only the damage.|} NL This Gu is capped at rank 7.

GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_REPLACE_GU_WORM.selecti: Your 15-card Gu capacity is full. Choose an existing Gu Worm to replace to obtain [gold]{NewCard}[/gold].
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_WEI_GUANG.title: Glimmer
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_WEI_GUANG.description: The next Light Path Attack deals 3 more damage. Exhaust.
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_JU_GUANG.title: Focused Light
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_JU_GUANG.description: The next Light Path Attack deals 6 more damage. A rank-8 source also creates an [gold]Afterglow[/gold] when played. Exhaust.
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_YU_HUI.title: Afterglow
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_YU_HUI.description: The next Light Path Attack deals 3 more damage. Exhaust. Final Generation.
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_JI_GUANG.title: Aurora
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_JI_GUANG.description: Gain 2 [gold]Brilliance[/gold]. The next Light Path Attack deals 8 more damage. Exhaust.
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_YUE_REN.title: Moonblade
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_YUE_REN.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If the target already has [gold]Illumination Break[/gold], deal {ZhaoPoBonus:diff()} more. A rank-7 source creates a [gold]Crescent[/gold] when this triggers Illumination Break. Exhaust.
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_CAN_YUE.title: Crescent
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_MAN_YUE_REN.title: Full Moon Blade
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_MAN_YUE_REN.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Deal {PerZhaoPo} more for each [gold]Illumination Break[/gold] on the target, up to {MaxZhaoPo}. Exhaust. Final Generation.
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_YU_MO.title: Jade Membrane
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_YU_GUANG_YI.title: Jade Light Garment
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_YU_GUANG_YI.description: Gain {Block:diff()} Block. A rank-8 source also gains 1 [gold]Brilliance[/gold]. Exhaust.
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_ZHE_GUANG.title: Refraction
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_ZHE_GUANG.description: Gain {Block:diff()} Block and 1 [gold]Brilliance[/gold]. Exhaust. Final Generation.
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_LIU_LI_YU_YI.title: Glazed Jade Garment
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_LIU_LI_YU_YI.descriptio: Gain {Block:diff()} Block and 2 [gold]Brilliance[/gold]. Retain. Exhaust. Final Generation.
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_YUE_NI_CHANG.title: Moon Raiment
GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_YUE_NI_CHANG.descriptio: Gain {Block:diff()} Block and {GuangHui} [gold]Brilliance[/gold]. From rank 3, create a [gold]Moonblade[/gold]; from rank 6 it is Upgraded; at rank 9 create a [gold]Full Moon Blade[/gold] instead. Exhaust.
